Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of TXN.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $4.22 per share.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 13% to 29% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2023.
Our cloud segment grew 13% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1068 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
